topic: Sanad offices track everyone else's documents, not their own
format: Speak peer-to-peer about carrying several hundred dates belonging to other people
post:
If you run a Sanad office, you are not tracking your own documents. You are tracking everyone else's.

Forty clients. Each one with a commercial registration, a municipality licence, an OCCI certificate. Some with work permits, some with fleets carrying driver licences and vehicle mulkiya, some with health certificates per employee.

That is not a calendar. That is several hundred dates belonging to people who assume you are watching them.

And you are — until the week two clients renew late and both of them remember it as your fault. In this business the product is not the paperwork. It is that nothing lapsed on your watch.

We built document expiry alerting for exactly this shape: documents held per client, each with its issuing authority and exact expiry date, with the reminder emailed ahead of time in Arabic and English rather than sitting on a screen someone has to open.

Let us be practical. You already know which clients will not renew until you chase them. The question is whether you find out ninety days early or the week it matters.
